offer.say: Okay, honest question, and you can be honest. Is my backhand a backhand, or is it more of a rumour? Dad called it 'a rumour' on CKVL once. On air. During a Lumber Kings broadcast. I wasn't even playing.

options.text: It's a rumour. Let's make it a fact.
It's more of a legend. Nobody's seen it.

why.say: Stick and puck. The pylons. Somebody to watch and tell me if I'm doing the thing where my top hand goes to sleep. I can't watch myself. I tried with my phone. I filmed the ceiling for an hour.

cheek.say: A legend! Okay, that's better than a rumour. That's an upgrade. Will you help me make it real though?

decline.say: No, totally, you've got a whole building. I'll just backhand the wall at home. Mom loves that.

accepted.say: You're the best. Okay. Pylons. Dad says they're in the rink somewhere, which is not helpful, Dad.

p_pylons.say: Earl says check with Doris. I don't know what that means. I'm scared to ask what that means.

complete.say: So? Be honest. Was it a backhand?

options.text: It was a backhand. A real one.
Your top hand fell asleep twice. But the third one was beautiful.

c_real.say: YES. I'm telling Dad. He'll say 'we'll see' on air. He got that off Hap Doyle. Here, have a pylon. I wrote my name on it. Well, Dad did. He has nicer writing.

c_honest.say: The third one! I felt the third one. Okay. Top hand awake. I'm writing it on my tape. Here, take a pylon. KENNY'S, DO NOT BORROW. Except you. You can borrow.

c_rumour.say: Potential. I'll take potential. Potential's how I got through high school. Here, a pylon, for your trouble.

done.say: Top hand awake. Top hand awake. Top hand awake.
